Turn on access, then return here to confirm your account.
An experiment. After you return, BackupDuck briefly opens Google Photos to confirm the account. It only turns on after confirmation.
This records your review and lets automatic cleanup try again later. It does not confirm a result or undo anything Google Photos started.
Stopping ends BackupDuck’s actions. Google Photos may continue.

When space runs low, BackupDuck uses accessibility access to tap Free up space in Google Photos. Google Photos decides what can be removed from this Pixel; those photos stay in its cloud. BackupDuck cannot check which photos are backed up.
